about_the_game:
🧢 Defeat the Virus with Your Wig!!!

🧠 ~ About the Game ~

Zurarararush!!! is a fast, funny, and deeply satisfying twin-stick shooter where you fight viruses using your ultimate weapon — a wig (ZURA)!

Play as a microscopic doctor wearing a Micro Suit,
equipping all kinds of ZURAs (wigs) to battle countless mutating viruses inside the human body.

The endless barrage of enemies and bullets will stimulate your brain,
and wiping them out in one burst delivers pure stress relief —
a loop of tension and release that feels incredibly addictive.
Enjoy short bursts of arcade-style flow and euphoria!

💫 ~ Gameplay Experience ~

  • Dodge, shoot, and collect wigs in a rush of frantic fun!

  • Feel the instant stress release when you clear out enemies.

  • A chaotic mix of bullet hell, comedy, and action for a truly unique brain-frying shooter.

Even in short sessions, you’ll reach that perfect arcade flow state!

💥 ~ About ZURA ~

Each ZURA (wig) offers a unique attack style.
Topknot, blonde curls, afro, pumpkin wig—each has different abilities and firepower.
And yes, you can stack multiple ZURAs at once!

Stacking wigs boosts your power dramatically,
but every ZURA has limited ammo (a.k.a. hair volume).
To survive, you must keep collecting new ZURAs and manage your firepower wisely!

🧬 ~ Game Modes ~

🎮 Arcade Mode (10 Episodes × 5 Stages × 3 Difficulties / ~10 Hours)

Experience 10 short stories across multiple stages,
each themed around love, family, and courage in the fight against infection.
Collect DNA and upgrade RPG-style to grow stronger and reach the ending—
accessible for players of all skill levels!

⚡ Score Attack Mode (4-Minute or Endless Mode / Infinite Replayability)

Choose between a 4-minute sprint or endless challenge and compete for the highest score worldwide!
Chain combos by defeating enemies and keep your streak alive by grabbing ZURAs.
Master the flow, rack up massive combos, and prove your wig power on the global leaderboards!

🦠 ~ Story ~

In the year 20XX, a mutated virus triggered a global pandemic.
Humanity was consumed by fear and despair...

Until scientists developed a new weapon — the ZURA,
a wig capable of directly attacking viruses.

Now, wearing your Micro Suit and humanity’s last hope on your head,
you must face the viral outbreak and save the world!

💬 ~ From the Developer ~

We created this game to bring back the pure arcade rush —
that short, intense feeling of joy that hits in just a few minutes of play.

“Wear it. Dodge it. Shoot like crazy!
Blow those viruses away with your ZURA!”
